product_name: Extensiv (suite: Extensiv Order Manager (formerly Skubana), Extensiv 3PL Warehouse Manager (formerly 3PL Central), Extensiv Integration Manager (formerly CartRover), Extensiv Network Manager)
target_segment: Mid-market to enterprise (high-volume brands, multi-channel retailers, and 3PLs); not a fit for SMB / hobbyist sellers due to pricing floor
target_vertical: Multi-channel ecommerce / DTC brands, omni-channel retailers, and 3PL providers (warehouse operators). Strong 3PL and marketplace coverage; minimal manufacturing focus
pricing_model: Tiered subscription, quote-based. Order Manager priced by order volume / revenue with no caps on users, warehouses, or channels. 3PL Warehouse Manager has published plan tiers (Merchant / EDI / 3PL / Master Account). Integration Manager priced per connection
starting_price_usd: Order Manager: starts around $1,000/month (some sources cite $400/month entry on Shopify App Store listing) [uncertain]. 3PL Warehouse Manager: from $39/month (Merchant), $99/month (EDI / 3PL), $199/month (Master Account)
free_trial_or_freemium: No free tier on Order Manager; demo / sales-led trial only. 3PL Warehouse Manager: 30-day free trial advertised on some listing pages [uncertain]
shopify_supported: Native (direct Shopify integration in Order Manager and via Extensiv Integration Manager / CartRover)
shopify_app_listing_url: https://apps.shopify.com/skubana (Extensiv Order Management); https://apps.shopify.com/cartrover (Extensiv Integration Manager)
shopify_app_rating: Extensiv Order Management Shopify listing: approximately 4.5-4.6 / 5 (varies by source) [uncertain]
shopify_install_count: Approximately 75-88 reviews on Shopify App Store listing for Order Management; install count not publicly disclosed [uncertain]
shopify_built_for_shopify_badge: No (no Built for Shopify badge documented) [uncertain]
shopify_plus_partner_status: Historically positioned for Shopify Plus merchants; explicit Shopify Plus Certified App Partner directory listing not confirmed [uncertain]
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional. Orders flow Shopify -> Extensiv; inventory levels, fulfillments, and tracking flow Extensiv -> Shopify. Product/variant data typically pushed/pulled at setup and synced on schedule
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory levels, orders, customers, fulfillments / shipments with tracking, refunds. Draft orders and refund line detail support is limited / not prominently documented [uncertain]
shopify_service_item_support: Not documented as a first-class feature; Extensiv is inventory/fulfillment-centric so non-physical / service items typically require manual handling or SKU mapping [uncertain]
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes - multiple Shopify stores per Extensiv tenant are supported; each store added as a separate sales channel
shopify_pos_support: Extensiv Order Management listing notes support for Shopify Lite and POS plans, but POS-specific workflows (in-person sale order routing) are not a documented core feature [uncertain]
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: Native handling of Shopify B2B catalogs / company locations / price lists is not documented [uncertain]
shopify_markets_support: No explicit Shopify Markets (multi-market pricing, duties, landed cost) support documented [uncertain]
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: Generic configurable metafield <-> custom field mapping is not documented as a feature; mapping is via SKU and core product attributes [uncertain]
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Variants map by SKU. Each variant is treated as a distinct SKU in Extensiv; bundles/kits can be mapped to component SKUs via 'Core Products'
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Order ingestion is near-real-time via webhooks / frequent polling; inventory sync is typically on a timed sync (minutes-level frequency) [uncertain on exact intervals]
shopify_known_limitations: Community-reported issues include occasional slow inventory sync causing overselling, syncing older / historical orders requires manual workflow, limited handling of certain Shopify-specific constructs (draft orders, B2B, Markets). Some users report support response variability
etsy_native_or_third_party: Third-party - Etsy connection is provided through Extensiv Integration Manager (CartRover) rather than a direct integration in Order Manager
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync-only (orders pulled, inventory/tracking pushed back); listing creation on Etsy is not a documented capability [uncertain]
etsy_inventory_sync: Inventory level push back to Etsy via Integration Manager on a scheduled sync; specific frequency not published [uncertain]
etsy_order_import: Scheduled / near-real-time pull through Integration Manager; orders standardized and routed to the WMS/OMS
etsy_synced_entities: Orders, inventory levels, shipment tracking (receipts/listings creation not supported) [uncertain]
etsy_known_limitations: Etsy variations and personalization options handling is not documented in detail; treated as line-item attributes via Integration Manager mapping [uncertain]
amazon_supported: Native (direct Amazon Seller Central integration in Order Manager via SP-API; also available via Integration Manager)
amazon_marketplaces: All major Amazon marketplaces supported (US, CA, MX, UK, EU, JP, AU); marketed as 'all international properties'
amazon_seller_types: FBA and FBM both supported; MCF (Multi-Channel Fulfillment) supported. Vendor Central support not documented as native [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings (read), inventory levels, FBA stock counts, orders, shipments / tracking, returns. Settlement report ingestion supported via SP-API. Customer messaging is not a documented feature [uncertain]
amazon_listing_creation: Primarily sync existing listings; bulk listing creation/updates via Extensiv are limited - Extensiv has indicated direction of encouraging customers to use Seller Central for listing workflows as Amazon deprecates older APIs
amazon_repricing_support: No built-in repricer; relies on third-party repricing tools
amazon_buy_shipping: Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase is not a documented native feature in Order Manager [uncertain]
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: FBA inbound shipment creation and management supported through Order Manager. Migration status to the new Fulfillment Inbound v2024-03-20 API is not publicly documented [uncertain]
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: Not publicly confirmed. Extensiv has publicly noted that Amazon is deprecating APIs it leverages and is steering customers to Seller Central for some FBA workflows [uncertain]
amazon_settlement_report_handling: Settlement reports ingested via SP-API; the platform reconciles settlements against AR and can post journal entries to accounting (QBO sync). Exact mapping of fees vs principal vs marketplace-collected tax is not deeply documented [uncertain]
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Marketplace-collected tax handling is not deeply documented; users often rely on accounting integration or third-party (e.g., A2X) to journal marketplace facilitator tax correctly [uncertain]
amazon_multi_account_support: Yes - multiple Amazon Seller accounts can be connected per tenant (each as a separate sales channel)
amazon_known_limitations: Some Amazon APIs Extensiv relies on are being deprecated; Extensiv has shifted some FBA workflows back toward Seller Central. Returns and customer messaging are less developed than core order/inventory sync
xero_supported: Third-party / partner integration (via Extensiv Integration Manager 'Xero Accounting Order Connection')
xero_app_store_certified: Not prominently listed on the Xero App Store as a certified app [uncertain]
xero_app_awards_recognition: No Xero Global App Award recognition documented [uncertain]
xero_app_store_rating: Not listed / no published rating on Xero App Store [uncertain]
xero_synced_entities: Sales orders / invoices (Xero Invoices passed as Orders into Extensiv), inventory quantities (optional push of available inventory to Xero). COGS journals, bills, and credit notes are not deeply documented in the Xero connection [uncertain]
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Closer to invoice_per_order via the Integration Manager Xero connection (Xero invoices treated as orders). Summary-journal posting is not a documented mode [uncertain]
xero_cogs_journal_method: Not explicitly documented; COGS journaling appears to be limited via the Xero connection (most COGS / accounting depth lives in the QBO integration) [uncertain]
xero_multi_currency: Multi-currency support not explicitly documented in the Xero connection [uncertain]
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes pass through on invoice mapping; specific GST/VAT mapping logic not deeply documented [uncertain]
xero_known_limitations: Xero integration is shallower than the QuickBooks Online integration; primarily handles Xero invoices as orders and optional inventory push-back. Each order line requires a SKU to sync properly
qb_online_supported: Yes - native, timed sync from Order Manager to QuickBooks Online
qb_desktop_supported: QuickBooks Desktop not natively supported by Order Manager (3PL Warehouse Manager billing has QB / QBO integration); typically requires third-party tools [uncertain]
qb_app_certified: Listed in Intuit ecosystem; QuickBooks App Store certification badge status not publicly confirmed [uncertain]
qb_app_store_rating: Not publicly tracked in search results [uncertain]
qb_synced_entities: Products, vendors, inventory, sales orders, purchase orders, bills (receipt of goods). One-way sync from Order Manager to QuickBooks Online
qb_accounting_sync_mode: Hybrid - sales orders / invoices and POs pushed individually (invoice_per_order style), with inventory and bills as separate flows. Pure summary-journal mode not documented
qb_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement style (inventory adjustments and bills flow through QBO as they occur); landed-cost-inclusive valuation not documented as native in QBO sync [uncertain]
qb_multi_currency: Multi-currency posting to QBO not explicitly documented [uncertain]
qb_class_location_mapping: QBO Class / Location dimension mapping not documented as a configurable field [uncertain]
qb_known_limitations: One-way only (Order Manager -> QBO); credit memos / refunds, marketplace facilitator tax journaling, and class/location mapping all weakly documented. Custom values for international orders also reported as limited
other_ecom_channels: Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, Amazon (all marketplaces), eBay, Walmart, Newegg, Sears, Rakuten, Etsy, Wayfair, Groupon, Google Shopping, PayPal, Wish, Houzz, custom carts and many more via Extensiv Integration Manager (CartRover) - 110+ ecommerce integrations, 80+ EDI retail partners. TikTok Shop support via Integration Manager [uncertain - explicit native listing]
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes. Order Manager splits bundle SKUs into core component SKUs and decrements components on sale; bundle on-hand quantity is calculated from core component availability
other_accounting_integrations: QuickBooks Online (native), Xero (via Integration Manager), NetSuite (via partner / integrator), Sage / Sage Intacct via partner integrations. No native MYOB, Zoho Books, FreshBooks, or Wave [uncertain on exact coverage]
bom_support: Limited. Bundles / kits with 'Core Products' approximate a single-level BOM. True manufacturing BOM is not a core feature
multi_level_bom: No - multi-level / nested BOMs are not a documented feature [uncertain]
production_orders: Assembly / kit assembly events supported in 3PL Warehouse Manager (Assembly transactions and webhooks). True manufacturing work orders with routings / operations are not a core feature
batch_lot_tracking: Yes - lot number tracking with expiry, FIFO/LIFO support in 3PL Warehouse Manager
serial_tracking: Yes - serial number tracking supported in 3PL Warehouse Manager
bin_location_support: Yes - bin / location tracking inside warehouses (3PL Warehouse Manager)
multi_warehouse: Yes - multiple warehouses with no documented hard cap; order splitting and routing across warehouses supported by Order Manager and Network Manager
barcoding: Yes - barcode generation and label support via SmartScan (3PL Warehouse Manager add-on) and label printing in Order Manager fulfillment workflows
purchase_orders: Yes - automated PO generation with reorder thresholds, partial receipts, supplier price lists. Order Manager's PO automation considers seasonality, sales velocity, and lead times
supplier_management: Yes - supplier records, lead times, supplier-SKU mappings, supplier-specific pricing. MOQ support exists but exposure is less prominently documented [uncertain]
landed_cost_support: Limited - landed cost (freight/duty/insurance) allocation to inventory cost is not deeply documented as a configurable feature [uncertain]
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Inventory valuation typically held in a single base currency; multi-currency valuation not documented [uncertain]
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes - automated demand forecasting using sales velocity, lead times, and seasonality; algorithmic rather than newer-style ML/LLM. Marketed as 'sophisticated algorithms' [uncertain whether ML-based]
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes - automated PO suggestions / drafts with replenishment alerts, considering lead times and sales velocity
ai_natural_language_query: No documented chat-style 'ask your inventory' natural language interface [uncertain]
public_api: Yes - REST API available across Extensiv products (Order Manager, 3PL Warehouse Manager, Integration Manager). Public REST API documentation at help.extensiv.com/rest-api
webhook_event_coverage: Webhooks supported in 3PL Warehouse Manager with seven event types: Order, Receipt, Adjustment, Assembly, Order Item, Item, Inventory Summary. Includes RSA-signed payloads, 3-second response window, ~6-hour retry, dead-letter queue for ~3 additional days
integration_architecture: Hybrid: native direct integrations on hot channels (Shopify, Amazon, QBO) plus an in-house iPaaS layer (Extensiv Integration Manager / CartRover) covering 100+ order sources and 80+ order destinations / WMSes
zapier_make_support: Zapier connector available for some Extensiv products; Make / n8n not officially documented [uncertain]
mobile_app: Yes - 3PL Warehouse Manager has mobile interface and SmartScan app for iOS / Android for warehouse picking, receiving, audits
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes - SmartScan runs on Android and iOS phones/tablets plus enterprise barcode hardware; supports picking, receiving, lot/serial capture, and audits
rate_limit_handling_documented: Generally not deeply public; some guidance in REST API docs about retry/dead-letter behavior for webhooks. Per-channel (Shopify / Amazon / Xero / QBO) throttle handling is internal and not publicly published [uncertain]
sync_frequency: Order ingestion typically near-real-time via webhooks / minutes-level polling. Inventory updates pushed on timed syncs (typically every few minutes). Accounting (QBO) sync runs on a timed schedule. Exact per-integration intervals are configurable and not always published [uncertain]
shipping_carrier_integrations: USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL eCommerce, UPS Mail Innovations, Canada Post, Royal Mail, Australia Post, and many more - direct integrations plus via ShipStation, ShippingEasy, and Small Parcel Suite
shipping_label_buying: Yes - in-app label purchase and printing supported in Order Manager and via ShipStation integration
three_pl_integrations: Yes - extensive 3PL coverage is a core strength. Integration Manager connects to 1000+ 3PLs / WMSes including Extensiv 3PL Warehouse Manager, ShipBob, ShipHero, Deliverr, FBA, and many bespoke 3PLs
edi_support: Yes - 80+ EDI retail partners supported via Extensiv Integration Manager (CartRover) and dedicated EDI Merchant plan in 3PL Warehouse Manager
g2_rating: Extensiv Order Manager: ~4.5 / 5 on G2 [uncertain on exact count]. Extensiv 3PL Warehouse Manager: rated on G2 but exact score and review count not pulled in search results [uncertain]
g2_grid_quadrant: Recognized in G2 grids for Order Management and Warehouse Management categories (Leader / High Performer tiers historically); exact current quadrant not confirmed [uncertain]
capterra_rating: Extensiv Order Management: 4.8 / 5 on Capterra (~107 reviews). Extensiv 3PL Warehouse Manager: separate Capterra listing with its own rating [uncertain on exact score]
notable_customers: Used by mid-market DTC brands and a large network of 3PLs across North America. Specific named case-study customers not summarized in search snippets [uncertain]
last_major_release: Extensiv 2025 Q3 Release Notes (Q3 2025) - Batch Item Audits in 3PL Warehouse Manager and reorganization of Returns under the Receipts menu; ongoing 2026 platform updates
owner_parent_company: Extensiv (independent SaaS company; formerly named 3PL Central). Mainsail Partners and other growth-equity firms are investors. No public acquisition by a larger parent at the time of writing [uncertain on full cap table]
last_funding_event: Reported total funding around $146M (cumulative). Acquired Skubana (April 2021), Scout Software (2021), and CartRover (2021); rebranded to Extensiv in May 2022. No recent public funding round disclosed in 2025-2026 search results [uncertain]
public_status_page_uptime: https://status.extensiv.com (Atlassian Statuspage); shows incident history and component status. Specific recent uptime % not summarized publicly [uncertain]
